_readme: Quote-only day trips for the group outings page. Leave pricing null. Do not add amounts.

outings.name: Kruger Full-Day Game Drive
outings.suits: Teams, friends, celebrations and first-time visitors
outings.summary: An open-vehicle game drive in Kruger National Park, with pickup in Phalaborwa or at Phalaborwa Gate. Breakfast and a light lunch are served in the park, and you are dropped off again afterwards. It is a long day with an early start.
includes: Pickup and drop-off in Phalaborwa or at the gate
Open safari vehicle and a field guide

outings.name: Olifants River Sundowner Cruise
outings.summary: A sunset boat safari on the Olifants River, a short drive from Phalaborwa, with wildlife viewing from the water. A morning cruise, or one with breakfast or a braai lunch, can be arranged if you book ahead.
includes: Optional breakfast or braai-lunch cruise when booked ahead
outings.note: Transport from Phalaborwa is arranged separately if you are not driving yourself.

outings.name: Blyde Canyon Boat Cruise
outings.summary: A guided cruise on the dam in Blyde River Canyon, out towards the tufa waterfall and views of the Three Rondavels. You may see hippo, crocodile and birds. It is a short outing unless you add viewpoints or lunch.
outings.note: Gate entry and transport from Phalaborwa are not included. Ask us if you want them arranged. Cruises can change with weather or water levels.

outings.name: Panorama Route Day
outings.suits: Friends, families and teams who want scenery
outings.summary: A full day from Phalaborwa along the Panorama Route: the Three Rondavels, Bourke's Luck Potholes, Lisbon Falls, God's Window and The Pinnacle. It is a scenery day, not a game drive.
includes: A snack, one juice and water

outings.name: Wildlife Rehabilitation Day
outings.summary: An educational day from Phalaborwa: a morning tour at a wildlife rehabilitation centre, lunch, then a visit to a reptile centre before the drive back. It is not a Kruger game drive.
outings.note: Tell us if the group is a school, and which day you have in mind. Sunday visits depend on the holiday calendar.

outings.name: Hoedspruit Wildlife Conservation Tour
outings.summary: A two-hour conservation tour near Hoedspruit, with morning and afternoon departures. It works as a shorter outing or a half-day. Transport from Phalaborwa is arranged separately.
outings.note: Book at least a day ahead. Meals can be added if you ask in time. We will confirm the day's times when you enquire.

outings.name: Elephant Morning Experience
outings.suits: Friends, celebrations and families with children aged 6 and older
outings.summary: An early start near Hoedspruit. Coffee or tea on arrival, then about 90 minutes with a small elephant herd and their carers. Children under 6 cannot join.
outings.note: Transfers are arranged separately. The visit runs daily, weather permitting. Please book ahead.

outings.name: Sunrise Balloon Flight
outings.summary: Meet before sunrise near Hoedspruit. Tea or coffee while the balloon is prepared, about an hour over farmland and riverine forest, then sparkling wine and a flight certificate. Passengers need to stand for the hour and climb into the basket. The minimum height is about 1.2 m, children under 7 cannot fly, and the flight is not open to anyone who is pregnant.
includes: Tea or coffee before you take off
Sparkling wine and a certificate after landing
outings.note: Not available 19 Dec to 2 Jan. Transfers are arranged separately. Flights depend on the weather and are often confirmed the afternoon before.

outings.name: Gorge Lift and Big Swing Adventure
outings.summary: A visit in Graskop: a lift down into the gorge and forest, and the big swing if you want the thrill. A gentler visit is the lift and forest walk only. The swing is for ages 12 and up.
includes: The lift and big swing, or the lift and forest walk if you prefer the milder option
outings.note: Transport from Phalaborwa is arranged separately. The site is open every day, weather permitting. Cafés are on site.

outings.name: Lowveld Team-Building Day
outings.suits: Companies, teams and groups of friends
outings.summary: A Lowveld day near White River. The full outing combines kayaking, a quad trail, paintball or archery, and a braai lunch. Shorter combinations can be arranged.
includes: The activities in the combination you choose
A braai meal on the full-day outing
outings.note: Transport from Phalaborwa is arranged separately. Tell us your date so we can confirm the day is running.

outings.name: Cape Town Icons Day
outings.suits: Companies, incentive groups and friends in Cape Town, or flying in
outings.summary: A private day in Cape Town, shaped around the ferry timetable: Robben Island, city stops such as Bo-Kaap and the Castle of Good Hope, and the Table Mountain cableway when the weather allows. This is not a Lowveld day trip. Flights are arranged separately.
includes: Collection and drop-off in Cape Town
Vehicle and guide for the road portion
Robben Island ferry, entrance and guided tour
outings.note: Lunch is not included. The ferry and the cableway depend on weather and the day's operations. We confirm both before you travel.

outings.name: Durban Sea and Water Park Day
outings.suits: Families, schools, friends and celebrations in Durban, or flying in
outings.summary: A day at Durban's sea-life aquarium and water park on a combined entry. The aquarium is open through the afternoon. Water-park days depend on the season, including school holidays. This is the entry itself, not a guided tour from Phalaborwa.
includes: Combined entry to the aquarium and the water park
outings.note: Flights, transport and meals are arranged separately. Cooler boxes and braais are not allowed inside. We confirm holiday opening days when you enquire.
